notes: Read the sole target and full context. Use context only to resolve the coalitions and President Obama. Quote the actual project name containing Our rather than treating it as narrator language. Preserve education, agitation and organizing as necessary, not sufficient, for stopping austerity.

claims.claim_text: Commitment for DSA to contribute the educational perspectives of GET UP (Grassroots Economics Training for Understanding and Power) and "The Other America is Our America" to coalitions resisting social-program cuts and supporting public investment and progressive revenue.
GET UP examines the neoliberal capitalist roots of the Great Recession and advances social-market economic alternatives.
The "The Other America is Our America" project explains the history of anti-poverty policy and advocates a new, substantive effort to combat poverty.
Education, agitation and organizing are necessary for DSA to stop corporate efforts to impose austerity.
Commitment for DSA to join street protests against the bipartisan effort to block the needs of constituencies that re-elected President Obama.
